Subject: RE: GPU slot triage + FinOps decision log — internal triage + proposal plan

Team — quick internal triage after Claire's note. Summary of recommended approach for the deal team: 

1) Commitment ask: 4 reserved slots, 6 weeks, start 2027-01-10. Provide staged availability clause (full availability by week 2 of start window) to reduce risk.
2) Pricing: use Q4 reserved ladder + one-time onboarding credit (we can offer 5% discount if PO received by 11/22). Laura, can you produce a 1-pager price breakout by EOD?
3) SLA excerpt: Karthik / Ben — can infra confirm a maintenance window policy (max 4 hours scheduled per month) and expected median p95 latency for smaller prompts (<=512 tokens)? We just need a blurb for procurement.
4) Burst fallback: propose automatic fallback to shared nimbus pool with pre-agreed burst cap. This should be in the MAP as an appendix.

Decision record: To keep this moving, I'm proposing we lock the following today — if internal approval + Laura's price doc ready by 11/18, Marissa will send itemized MAP + draft PO to Claire and procurement. If infra signals a hard constraint on start date, we escalate to FinOps for swap of slot windows.

Attachments referenced: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf) — draft MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria.

Thanks — Marissa

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com, claire.brooks@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-14T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GPU slot triage + FinOps decision log — infra confirmation + sloting plan

Marissa / team — infra check complete. Short answers: 

• Availability: We can commit to the 4 reserved slots with start 2027-01-10 provided PO and signed MAP are in flight; full capacity guaranteed by 2027-01-17 (week 2) due to provisioning lead times. We will include a staged start clause as you suggested.

• SLA excerpt (for procurement): "Scheduled maintenance windows not to exceed 4 hours per calendar month; target uptime 99.5% for reserved slots; median p95 latency for 512-token interactive calls: 180–220ms (internal benchmark on p4d-equivalent)." (Editable).

• Burst fallback: Ben confirmed burst quota of up to 20% of reserved tokens to the shared nimbus pool for the pilot; any overage will follow standard burst billing and will be highlighted in the MAP.

Action items assigned: 
- Laura: publish the price breakout + discount language by 11/18.
- Marissa: send itemized MAP + PO draft to Claire and procurement once Laura confirms pricing.
- Stephanie (FinOps): please confirm whether the proposed 5% early-PO discount is acceptable from a revenue recognition view.

I'll slot a short 15-min bridge if anyone prefers to sign off live.

—Karthik
